Class NaturalEarthAttributeClassifier

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.NaturalEarthAttributeClassifier
public final class NaturalEarthAttributeClassifier extends Object
Cliodynamic and Anthropological Attribute Classifier for Natural Earth Country Features. Provides lookup and heuristic mapping for sovereignty, isogloss branches, Todd/Murdock kinship typologies, confessional distributions, state capacity, technology, and ecological footprints.
